title: permission-gate extension
description: Defense-in-depth stack: layer 0 AgentFS+YoloFS (FUSE/SQLite COW filesystem boundary), layer 1 profile tool whitelist, layer 2 profile op whitelist (TypeBox schema union), layer 3 own dcg (.toml pattern packs, bun-native, PreToolUse hook) + Reinforced Agent reviewer (light.sock Gemma4-E2B, escalates to remote qwen3.6 for destructive ops) + slb peer approval for DANGEROUS tier. harnessIntervention pattern for all hook overrides. Profiles: full/coder/reviewer/coordinator/watchdog stored in ~/.pi/profiles/. Bubblewrap retained for readonly shell.

title: CI: GitHub Actions release workflow
description: GitHub Actions workflow to build release artifacts on tag push: launcher binary per platform (linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64), pi binary per platform (same matrix), data.tar.gz (cross-platform, single). Upload all to GitHub Release. Use bun scripts/build-release.ts --bin-only for binaries, --data-only for data.

title: grep: context + glob params
description: context param: -B N -A N rg flags. batContextHighlight in renderResult already handles surrounding lines. glob param: --glob <pattern> rg flag to scope search without restricting path. Both are single-param additions to grep schema.

title: edit: fuzzy matching via linehash
description: When old_text doesn't match exactly, delegate to linehash edit --fuzzy. Covers: Unicode quote/dash/space normalization, whitespace normalization, multi-pass fallback. Most common agent friction point. Extension stays thin; all matching logic in linehash CLI.

title: find: sort/filter ops
description: Add sortBy(name|mtime|size) to glob op. Add recent op: {op:recent,path,modifiedSince,limit} → fd --changed-within. Add sized op: {op:sized,path,minSize?,maxSize?} → fd --size. Nu pipeline sort after fd for sortBy.

title: quality stack: output-parser, write-guard, read-guard, quality-monitor
description: output-parser: turn_end hook; detect fenced/tagged/bare-JSON tool calls in assistant text; repairJson 6-pass; nudge via pi.sendUserMessage deliverAs:followUp. write-guard: tool_call hook; path normalization; block write to existing→redirect to edit. read-guard: tool_result hook; ctx.getContextUsage() overflow trim to 30 lines. quality-monitor: turn_end; empty/hallucinated-tool/loop/malformed checks; read-loop detection; patch-spiral detection.

title: turn-cap + finalize-warn
description: turn-cap: turn_start hook; ctx.abort() at LITTLE_CODER_MAX_TURNS (or systemPromptOptions.littleCoder.maxTurns); resets on before_agent_start. finalize-warn: fires once when WARN_REMAINING=5 turns remain; pi.sendUserMessage deliverAs:followUp with explicit Answer: instruction. Independent of turn-cap.

title: skill-inject + knowledge-inject
description: skill-inject: before_agent_start; loads skills/tools/*.md (frontmatter: target_tool, token_cost); 3-priority: error-recovery(last failed tool) > recency(last 2 calls) > intent(INTENT_MAP keyword); 300 tok budget; research-trigger directive. knowledge-inject: before_agent_start; skills/knowledge+protocols/*.md (topic,keywords,token_cost,requires_tools); keyword-score threshold 2.0 cap 150 tok/entry; publishes requires_tools for skill-inject.

title: Nu foundation + Flox env
description: Flox env (flox.nix): pins nu, rg, fd, eza, bat, delta, ast-grep, linehash, sd. Activated at pi-dev.ts launcher. Nu wrappers in nu/lib/ (grep/find/ls/read/diff/query/bat/sd/outline); use little-coder *. TypeScript extension → thin adapter calling runNu(). Nu isolated config: nu/config.nu + nu/env.nu. Agent can use same Nu wrappers in shell tool.

title: extra-tools: repo_map, scratchpad, session, outline
description: repo_map: git+modified files(cap 10)+file map+entrypoints+build scripts; expansion: aider tree-sitter symbol graph. scratchpad: session-local JSONL; ops add/get/list/remove/clear; always-inject mode: before_agent_start injects as [ACTIVE_CLIPBOARD] block. session: Zellij-backed pane sessions; create/exec/write/read/list/close; file registry ~/.pi/sessions/; flox/direnv auto-detect; reset op + footer [exit=N cwd=... timed_out=bool]. outline: universal-ctags; Nu wrapper joins ctags JSON+linehash anchors; {name,kind,line,anchor,signature}.

title: extra-tools/effort: thinking-budget injection
description: before_model_request hook. Reads active thinking level from Pi session. Looks up compat.thinkingBudgets[level] in models.json. Injects thinking_budget_tokens: N into request body. Pi owns thinkingFormat+thinkingLevelMap (format translation). lemonade must start without --reasoning-budget (default -1). Per-profile defaults: coordinator=high(16384), coder=medium(6144), reviewer=low(2048), watchdog=off.

title: ops[] universal schema migration
description: Migrate all 8 basic-tools to {ops: Op[]} discriminated union schema. New op variants: grep summary (rg --count-matches per file), grep scope→ast_search. edit replace_symbol (linehash edit --symbol), edit patch (linehash patch --apply with anchored diff). find recent (fd --changed-within), find sized (fd --size), find glob+sortBy. linehash extensions needed: diff --anchored, patch --apply, edit --symbol.

title: extra-tools/model: model router + model_switch
description: Automatic router: local Gemma4-E2B ONNX via @huggingface/transformers+Bun, light.sock, classifies each message before pi calls lemonade; output {escalate,model,effort}. model_switch tool: {op:model_switch,model?,effort?}; no-arg=escalate to profile.escalation. Pi re-registration: pi.unregisterProvider('lemonade')+re-register with new defaultModel. Always writes updated (model,effort) to profiles.json. Event routing: chat→light.sock, inbox/task→remote pro.

title: computeDiff → linehash diff
description: Replace npm diff createPatch with linehash diff subcommand. Removes Index:/=== artifacts from content.text (LLM-visible). tool_result hook already replaces details.diff for TUI rendering, but LLM still sees artifacts via content.text. linehash diff must output clean unified diff compatible with delta rendering.

title: evidence + evidence-compact
description: EvidenceAdd(source,note,snippet), EvidenceGet(id), EvidenceList() tools. Per-session in-memory store keyed by LITTLE_CODER_SESSION_ID. Cleared on session_shutdown. Survives pi compaction via session_compact hook bridge message. Complements grove (grove=persistent cross-session semantic; evidence=ephemeral per-session citable facts).

title: grove extension: seeds/mulch/trellis/canopy ops
description: Pi extension wrapping seeds/mulch/trellis/canopy CLIs as pi tools. os_read (read seeds issues, mulch records, trellis specs/plans, canopy prompts), os_write (create/update), os_search (mulch query, seeds list, trellis search), os_promote (mulch rank/outcome, seeds close). Orientation Block: before_agent_start cold-start detection via seeds/trellis; synthesize [ORIENTATION] block if idle >1h.

title: passive UI: basic-tool-grouping + thinking-steps
description: basic-tool-grouping: hooks tool events; groups consecutive structural-tool cards under ├/└ glyphs with role icons (◫ read/grep/find/ls, ✎ edit/write, ▸ shell, ⌕ ast_search, ↩ revert_file). thinking-steps: patches AssistantMessageComponent.prototype; reference-counted via Symbol. Both require tool-execution-patch for spacer suppression.

title: recap + command-history + tool-execution-patch
description: recap: vendored capy-tools; uniform narration tool; before_agent_start system prompt discipline; renderCall italic. command-history: vendored capy-tools; pi.on(input); per-cwd JSONL ~/.pi/folder-history/; ctrl+up/down recall; ctx.ui.setStatus footer. tool-execution-patch: vendored capy-tools; patches ToolExecutionComponent.prototype.render; suppresses blank spacer lines for grouped tools; registerToolDefinitionOverride for third-party rendering.

title: web-tools: fetch, search, control, source
description: fetch: flyscrape+defuddle/readability pipeline, Nu wrapper from fetch.nu, ops get/crawl. search: ddgr+SearXNG, Nu wrapper from search.nu, ops query/searxng. control: browser-cli Firefox automation, ops open/snap/click/type/read/eval/shot/close. source: Sourcegraph, ops search/file. Artifact storage: <5KB inline, ≥5KB → ~/.pi/fetch/<ts>-<slug>/ or .pi/fetch/ (target:repo). Flox additions: flyscrape, ddgr, browser-cli.

title: docs-tools: doc_read, doc_ocr, doc_extract
description: doc_read: officeparser(npm,docx/pptx/xlsx/odt/pdf/rtf/csv→Markdown+RAG)+docling(Python CLI,complex PDFs/tables/scanned); Nu wrapper picks backend by format; artifacts ≥5KB → .pi/docs/<ts>-<slug>/; chunks → grove mulch. doc_ocr: MiniCPM5-1B via ocr.sock, ops image/region. doc_extract: NuExtract3-1B via extract.sock, schema-in+text-in → structured JSON. Adds ocr.sock+extract.sock to local worker set.

title: backend binaries distribution
description: Distribute backend tool binaries under ~/.little-coder/bin/: nu, rg, fd, eza, bat, delta, ast-grep, linehash, tru. Per-platform compiled binaries as additional release assets or via Flox manifest baked into data.tar.gz. Launcher prepends ~/.little-coder/bin/ to PATH before spawning pi. Eliminates dependency on ambient PATH for backend tools.

title: shell: starship-style render (cwd header, ❯ prompt, right-aligned ✓/✗ + runtime)
description:
Render shell tool output with a starship-like header + prompt frame in expanded mode.

Header line (cwd left, status right-aligned to pane width):
  ~/repo                                              ✓ 1m 2s

Prompt + command line:
  ❯ <command>

Then the existing command output verbatim.

Requirements:
- Status glyph: ✓ on exit 0, ✗ (red) on non-zero, with exit code suffix (e.g. ✗ 127).
- Runtime formatted human-friendly: <1s → ms (e.g. 480ms), <60s → Ns (e.g. 12s), else Nm Ns (e.g. 1m 2s).
- Cwd: render with ~ for HOME, abbreviate long paths if needed.
- Right-align respecting theme.terminalWidth; degrade gracefully on narrow panes (drop padding, keep status on a second line).
- Collapsed mode unchanged (existing one-line summary).
- Schema-additive only; default behavior should produce the new look. If a kill-switch is needed, add display: "starship" | "plain" with starship as default.

Touchpoints: .pi/extensions/basic-tools/src/shell.ts (renderResult), display.ts (helpers for right-align + status badge).

Acceptance:
- bun .pi/extensions/basic-tools/src/invoke.ts shell '{"command":"echo hi"}' shows starship-style expanded output.
- Non-zero exit shows red ✗ + code.
- Runtime visible in header.
- Tester confirms rendering in tester pane (dump with ANSI).
